title: That Old Black Magic
start: Speak to Lady Grey in the City of Um's bandstand.

items.t: 2 Elemental I, 1 Change I, and 1 Commune I
13 basic ghostly ink and 2 regular ghostly ink from scratch
Animated drumsticks (may obtain during the quest)

recommended.t: Archaeology journal for a quick teleport to the Everlight Dig Site
Underworld Grimoire for a quick teleport to the City of Um
Glyphs and focus for lesser ensoul material or lesser communion rituals with 1 Speed I or higher alteration glyph
1 ectoplasm, 2 regular ghostly ink, 1 basic ghostly ink at minimum from scratch

kills.t: Dragith Nurn (level 26; must be killed with necromancy)
Multiple kills of Hermod, the Spirit of War (level 732)
May be skipped if you have already obtained the animated drumsticks.

rewards.t: If you have fully completed all 4 subquests and the quest "That Old Black Magic", you will have received the following:
Necromancy XP lamp for 5000 Necromancy XP
rewards.l: Necromancy XP lamp (My One and Only Lute)

rewards.t: Necromancy XP lamp for 7500 Necromancy XP
Necromancy XP lamp for 12500 Necromancy XP
Necromancy XP lamp for 20000 Necromancy XP
